profile.headline: Distinguished Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
Software Engineer and Software Architect with over twenty years of experience developing and maximizing the effectiveness of software development teams.  Demonstrated ability to choose the right tools and to coach team members to use those tools for maximum impact.  Expert web services developer who understands how to work with clients to quickly deliver solutions that exceed expectations.  

Expert in PHP, Perl, Python, Linux, OOA&D, PostgreSQL, ETL (Extraction, Transformation and Loading), LAMP, Agile, and Git.  Extensive experience with Java, C, C++, Bash, Design Patterns, Oracle, CSS, XML, REST, and JSON.  Professional experience with Lucene, PyUnit, ASP, ColdFusion, SQLServer, MySQL, Redis, ODBC, Excel, IIS.

positions.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
positions.description: Domain Lead Engineer for Capital One's Accounting and Reporting tower in the Finance Tech division.  Technical lead for 25 applications (in-house build, 3rd Party hosted, and 3rd Party SaaS products).  Lead Software and Application Architect for those 25 applications.  Architecture Review Board member for Finance Tech.  Lead Software Architect for the $185M FinX program which replaced 25 year old PeopleSoft ERP system with Workday ERP (estimated delivery Summer 2027).  Authored FinX architecture documents, design documents, requirements documents, automated test strategy documentation, and development standards as the framework for the delivery of an abstraction layer around Workday to manage the ingestion of over 100 automated data feeds and the publication of 30+ output datasets. Authored over 40 Architecture Decision Records to support architectural evolution and consistency across the 100+ software engineers and 20+ development teams in Finance Tech.  Championed the introduction and adoption of AI development tools include Windsurf, Claude Code, and GitHub CoPilot for the 40+ developers and 10+ teams in the Accounting and Reporting tower.  Created AI skills to compare code produced versus relevant ADRs stored in Atlassian Confluence and highlight applications that violate approved ADRs.  Created and maintained the 3-Year Architecture Plan and Domain Destination Architecture for the Accounting and Reporting tower.

positions.title: Sr. Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
As the lead engineer, I spearheaded the re-imagining of the CapitalOne Accounts Payable process.  I took the existing CSV/batch transfer process and updated it to be a streaming, near-real-time, micro-services based process - providing a mechanism to allow the seamless migration of invoice producers from the old system to the new system.  Also developed a JSON document validation tool that allowed us to perform validation earlier in the process which resulted in saving several thousand man hours per year of manually fixing invoices after they had been loaded into the General Ledger.

I was then named the Technical Lead for CapitalOne's General Ledger system - a 20 year old behemoth of an application that was suffering from a lack of care and feeding.  I reorganized the core application components and lead the implementation of several APIs insulating the application.  I reconstructed the technical documentation, rebuilt architecture diagrams, defined target state, and rehabilitated the reputation of the application and the team

positions.title: Master Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked primarily as a DevOps SME in a Shared Services group under the Capital One Card division.  Contributed a post-deployment kubernetes cluster validation tool using Chef Inspec and python.  Provided customer support for the Capital One Enterprise Build pipeline based on Jenkins - on call support, slack channel support, and in person/conference call office hours sessions.  Provided a metrics collection module for the Jenkins shared library that the Enterprise Build pipeline was based on.

Led a team that was selected the overall winner for an internal hackathon to reduce start-up times for virtual machines - specifically in response to autoscaling events in AWS.  Backend developer for a team that made it to the final round of judging for a second internal hackathon - provided a tool to open up docker containers, extract metadata from the containers, and write that data back into a JFrog Artifactory instance as tags.  Also provided a system to search that metadata using an external UI.

Primary Technologies:  Python, Groovy.  AWS, Jenkins, Kubernetes.

positions.title: Chief Software Architect
positions.description:
The Center for American Progress is a DC-based think tank that promotes progressive policies.  

Responsible for the availability and development of approximately 40 different web properties.  Acquired a deep understanding of WordPress - sites, themes, and plugins.  Managed AWS assets including EC2s, ELBs, RDS instances, ElastiCache, CloudFront distributions, and CodeDeploy applications.  Wrote tools and applications against the AWS API, automating some of the management of those assets as well as doing some auditing of how those assets are configured.  Defined standards, policies and procedures for the team.  Conducted internal training sessions on a number of topics including Object Oriented PHP,  SQL Fundamentals, regular expressions.  Built a series of software integrations primarily in Python between Ceridian's DayForce HCM, SalesForce, Eloqua, SmartSheet, Google Tools, JIRA, GitHub, GoDaddy, NGPVan, GumRoad and others.

Key Concepts/Technologies: Python, AWS, WordPress, PHP, MySQL, git/GitHub, Perl, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Bash, AlertLogic, grunt/gulp, JIRA, Confluence, Slack, SmartSheet, Google Suite APIs, SalesForce, Eloqua.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · PHP · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MySQL · WordPress

positions.title: Principal Software Developer and Chief Technical Officer
positions.description:
Swapasap was social media website designed to facilitate language learning for students by allowing students to locate and communicate with others who can help them master a language primarily through text chat, video chat and arranging in-person visits.  

Acted as Chief Technology Officer and Principal Software Developer. Built Swapasap from the ground up. Made all Technology decisions including platforms, architecture, and tools selection. Wrote 90% of the code and directed the development of the remaining 10%. Mentored two software engineering interns and taught Software Testing principles and basic User Interface Coding techniques to non-technical team members.

Key Concepts/Technologies – PHP, Perl, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, CSS, HTML, PostgreSQL, Redis, Debian Linux, Apache, Facebook API, Google Maps API, Google Translate API, Google Places API, Freichat, Bash, Git, PoEdit
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Perl · PostgreSQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Social Media

positions.title: Principal Support Engineer
positions.description:
Mandiant's Product Support Team was responsible for configuring and purchasing hardware, OS and application installation, product deployment, ongoing telephone, email, and on-site support and troubleshooting, as well as internal and external training.

Supported internal and external customers with problem solving and training and ensured that customers achieved success using Mandiant products. Provided 24x7 on-site and remote assistance for the MIR product for 3 years resulting in a 100% service contract resubscription rate. Trained new Mandiant personnel, mentored junior members of the support group, and moderated the online MIR forums.

Key Concepts/Technologies – Product Support, Python, Bash, Perl, Gentoo Linux, desk.com, Salesforce

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mandiant was an IT Security consulting firm whose CEO (Kevin Mandia) wanted a big, red "Find Evil" button for corporate networks.  MIR (Mandiant Intelligent Response) was the initial product offering delivering that capability.

Fourth Software Engineer hired by Mandiant for MIR development. Primarily focused on Python development of a Linux-based Controller middleware component for job management, web services, file storage and task scheduling. Delivered version 1 of MIR in time for a large marketing effort at the RSA conference in January 2008.

Key Concepts/Technologies – Python, Twisted, SSL, Lucene, PostgreSQL, SQLite, XML, PyUnit, Perl, Bash, Scrum, Nginx, XML, Subversion, Eclipse, REST

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Alliances.ORG was a boutique software development and web-hosting consultancy that engaged with partner organizations in the online shopping, audio/video production, import/export auditing, and corporate communications spaces.

Served as both a Technical Lead and a Development Team member for contract development projects. Led a four-person development team building a PHP site tightly integrated with eBay. Built a custom MS Access application populated by Perl-parsed screen captures, Microsoft Access files and Excel spreadsheets for a law firm to audit imports and exports. Built an ASP and Microsoft Access intranet-based total compensation statement for a law firm that drew data from ProBusiness, Excel Spreadsheets, and Perl-parsed screen captures. 

Hosted email and web services for up to 15 clients. Performed Linux system administration duties during this time.

Key Concepts/Technologies – PHP, Apache, PostgreSQL, eBay API, Smarty Template engine, MS Access, Perl, ETL, ASP, IIS, CSV, Linux, Bind, Postfix, Apache, SSH, System Administration

Alliances Library – Primary architect for a set of libraries that implement common web development tasks in Java, PHP, Perl, Tcl, ASP and Python.  On SourceForge [SourceForge].
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Perl · Linux System Administration · PostgreSQL · Consulting

positions.title: Apps Developer II
positions.description:
The Network Operations, On-Premises Web Development team was an embedded software development organization within the Long Distance Network Operations Center.  This was team was tasked with building operational tools with short delivery times to help keep Sprint's network up and running.

Developed and maintained over 75 different applications in several different languages on several different platforms. Standardized the development process for the team (6 to 14 developers). Improved code reuse, and streamlined development and deployment processes. Improved maintenance capabilities by creating a shared look and feel between languages and applications.

Key Concepts/Technologies – PHP, Perl, CVS, Eclipse, Java, JavaScript, TCL/Expect, AJAX, Linux, Windows 2000, Windows NT, Solaris, ASP, ColdFusion, Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQLServer, JSP, Bash
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Perl · Linux System Administration · TCL · PostgreSQL · Oracle Database Administration
